note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a KYR 13, 16; A06b KYR 13, 16; L05 KYR 26): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Dual citizenship restriction), A01b (descent, born abroad: Dual citizenship restriction), A02a (birth in country: No provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: not by birth in the territory alone (provisions for foundlings and children otherwise stateless, modes A03a and A03b, aren't held by the form); by descent from either parent, a child born abroad on the limit the dataset states. The coding also records a dual-citizenship restriction on descent, which the form doesn't hold. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Kyrgyzstan, 2024
sources.said: Person has had 5 years of continuous and uninterrupted residence in the country. ... n.a. ... Person acquires citizenship of States bordering Kyrgyzstan (Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan and China). ... Dual citizenship restriction ... Person is born in Kyrgyzstan to parents who are both citizens, or to an only father or mother who is a citizen. If only one parent is a citizen, the parents' written consent is required. ... Dual citizenship restriction ... Person is born abroad to parents who are both citizens. If only one parent is a citizen, the child is considered in principle a Kyrgyz citizen unless it is renounced by the parents in a joint written application and the child gets another foreign citizenship at birth. If only one parent is a citizen and the other one is stateless or unknown, the child is considered a Kyrgyz citizen. ... No provision ... No provision

atBirth.descentAbroad: Person is born abroad to parents who are both citizens. If only one parent is a citizen, the child is considered in principle a Kyrgyz citizen unless it is renounced by the parents in a joint written application and the child gets another foreign citizenship at birth. If only one parent is a citizen and the other one is stateless or unknown, the child is considered a Kyrgyz citizen.
